overall_goal: Set up the cooking station, manage the cooking chicken, and prepare the workspace for serving and weighing.

goals.description: Set up the electric hob and pan for cooking
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a pan, clears space by moving the weighing scale, plugs in and turns on the electric hob, and positions the pan on the burner.
The person brings the bowl of chicken marinade to the cooking area and searches through drawers to find the appropriate spatula and tongs for cooking.

goals.description: Prepare the workspace and discard lettuce core
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a bowl, clears space on the countertop, manages the chopping board and knife, throws away the lettuce core, and gathers the shredded lettuce into a neat pile.

goals.description: Check and manage the cooking chicken
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly picks up and puts down the tongs to check on the chicken cooking in the pan, and adjusts the heat on the electric hob.

goals.description: Retrieve a fork from the cutlery drawer
goals.rationale: The person opens the cabinet and cutlery drawer to get a fresh fork, then closes the drawer and cabinet before putting the fork down.

goals.description: Transfer the cooked chicken to a serving bowl
goals.rationale: The person selects a suitable serving bowl from the upper shelf and uses tongs to move all the cooked chicken pieces from the hot pan into the bowl, then places the bowl on a cooling rack.

goals.description: Wash the empty marinade bowl and rinse hands
goals.rationale: The person turns on the tap to scrub and rinse out the empty chicken marinade bowl, empties the water, shakes off excess water, and dries their hands with a rag.

goals.description: Set up the weighing scale for the washed lettuce
goals.rationale: The person clears the weighing scale, places a conical bowl on it, turns the scale on, and positions the sieve of washed lettuce over the bowl to prepare for weighing.
